info.name: Kiteworks API Documentation activities clients API

params.name: name:contains
params.description: Client name. Search for results that contain the specified characters in this parameter.

params.name: description:contains
params.description: Client description. Search for results that contain the specified characters in this parameter.

params.name: mode
params.description: Determines the detail level of the response body.

items.docs: Returns a list of registered OAuth clients. Hidden clients are excluded from the results.

params.name: returnEntity
params.description: If set to `true`, returns information about the newly created entity.

params.name: mode
params.description: Determines the detail level of the response body.

items.docs: Creates a new OAuth client (e.g. a custom mobile app). The response includes the plain-text `client_secret`, which is only returned once at creation time and cannot be retrieved again.
Returns the settings of the OAuth client used to make the current request (e.g. pin timeout, token lifetime).

params.name: id
params.description: The unique identifier of the client.

items.docs: Returns the settings for the specified OAuth client (e.g. an iOS mobile app), including token lifetimes, PIN policy, scope, and OAuth flow configuration.

params.name: id
params.description: ID of the client to be updated

items.docs: Updates the settings for the specified OAuth client. The fields available for update depend on the client type: custom clients support `name`, `description`, `redirectUri`, `accessTokenLifetime`, `refreshTokenLifetime`, `scope`, and `signatureKey`; built-in clients support only `accessTokenLifetime` and `refreshTokenLifetime`.

params.name: id
params.description: ID of the client to be deleted

items.docs: Deletes the specified OAuth client. Built-in system clients cannot be deleted.

params.name: id
params.description: ID of the client whose scopes to be retrieved

params.name: mode
params.description: Determines the detail level of the response body.

items.docs: Returns the list of API resource scopes the specified client is authorized to access, such as folders, files, members, and comments.
